_doc: Polymaker PolyLite ABS, printed, for analysis: stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z). Printed values vary with the printer, settings and spool: low and high are the data sheet's own spread either side; measure your own (the lever bench does) and record it as kind measured.
name: abs

modulus.rule: Young's modulus along the layers (x-y), ± 58.2. Bambu Lab's ABS sheet (V2.0) gives 3800 ± 190 MPa by ISO 527 but 1880 MPa in bending, far from this and from its own bending figure, so it is not used
modulus.source: Polymaker PolyLite ABS technical data sheet V5.6, 2025-12-30 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040), https://polymaker.com/wp-content/uploads/lana-downloads/TDS_Polymaker_PolyLite-ABS_V5.6_2025-12-30_EN.pdf

modulus_z.source: Polymaker PolyLite ABS technical data sheet V5.6 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength.rule: Tensile strength along the layers (x-y). The sheet's spread for it is a misprint (± 92.7, the line above's), so it carries no range
strength.source: Polymaker PolyLite ABS technical data sheet V5.6 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength_z.source: Polymaker PolyLite ABS technical data sheet V5.6 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio (Polymaker publish none): an estimate for a printed amorphous plastic, as the kit takes PLA's (0.36) and PETG's (0.38)
poisson.source: An estimate of @rulecad/rules: no maker's data sheet gives one

density.source: Polymaker PolyLite ABS technical data sheet V5.6 (ISO 1183, GB/T 1033)
